I'd like to be dry again, one day.

I keep seeing the grave in my mind.

I keep thinking about that body.

It gets lonely.

I need something to do that isn't work.

I could really use a drink.

And, er, I may have had a drink or two.
Is the ground moving, or is it me?
My stomach's in a bad way. Something I ate.
That last meal wasn't fit for pigs.
The food's been grim lately.
That last meal was something else, though.
Good food helps more than you'd think.
And I'm sleeping well in that room of mine.
My room is a miserable hole, though.
Those dark little rooms with no windows get to me.

That feast was a disappointment, though. Let's not pretend otherwise.
That last gathering lifted my spirits.
And we sent those raiders running, didn't we?
I can't stop thinking about that raid. We lost.
I had the loveliest dream last night.
I had a horrible dream last night. Can't shake it.

I'm still sore from that fight.
I feel like dancing!

And I've been comfortable, for once.
I can't stop thinking about that hanging.
And I'm trying not to think about what we've been eating. Or who.
Nothing much. The work, mostly.
Oh, this and that. Whether the roof will hold. Whether the crops will.
Just wondering what next year will bring.
Whether we'll still be here in ten years.
Nothing worth your time.
I was thinking about {town}. I wonder what's left of it.
My old home, {town}. Funny what you miss.

We're well stocked, at least. That's a comfort.

Just getting through the winter. One day at a time.
Spring. I'm thinking about spring.
Spring. Time to plant, and time to hope.

Long days. Good for work, bad for sleeping.
The one we lost. I keep thinking I'll see them at supper.
{Rival}, if you must know. We don't get along, and it's getting worse.
Honestly? How to get through a day without arguing with {rival}.

How quiet it is. Just me and the wind out here.
Whether anyone else is out there. Whether they'll come.
How much this place has grown. {Pop} of us now!

The old gods. I wonder if they followed us here.
There's an old oak near here. I think it's sacred.
That raid. We stood together. I won't forget it.
That raid. We weren't ready.
Whether I should just leave. I don't mean it. Mostly.
How everything goes wrong, no matter what I do.
Why some folk get a room of their own and others don't.

The stars. You can see so many out here, far from the towns.
How new this all is. A few days ago this was empty land.
That dream. I keep thinking about that dream.
Wha-? Oh. Nothing. Absolutely nothing. Is there more ale?
Supper. I'm always thinking about supper.
When the next fight will come. I'm getting restless.
Everything, and nothing. The way the clouds move.

Nothing I can think of.
Just more hours in the day.
Nothing, really. It's kind of you to ask.
Food. Anything. Please.
A proper meal would be welcome.
Something to eat, if there's anything going.
Sleep. Let me rest a while, would you?
A bed. A real bed, under a roof.
Somewhere to sleep that isn't the dirt.
Warmer clothes. Or a fire. Either would do.
Something warm to wear.
Some shade, and a drink of water.
Someone to look at this {wound}, before it festers.

A room of my own. I'd look after it.
Better food. I don't mean to complain, but...

To be spared the {hated}, if you can manage it.

Steady.

Slow, but it's moving.

Good! I got to spend the day at {loved}.
Slow. I can barely keep my eyes open.
I can't keep my mind on it.
Badly. My heart's not in it.

Work? Is that today?

topics.label: What do you make of the village?

say: It's a start. More than we had.
{Village}? It's ours. That counts for something.
Rough around the edges. Like the rest of us.
Small. Just {pop} of us. Every pair of hands matters.
It's just me. A village of one.
It's growing. {Pop} souls now. Who'd have thought?
It's a proper village now. Maybe a town one day.
We need more food in the stores. {Food} won't see us far.
There's nothing in the stores. That's what I make of it.
The stores are full. That lets a body sleep at night.
It's a bit of a mess, if I'm honest.
It's becoming beautiful. I mean that.
Strong. We showed the raiders that.
Weak. That raid showed it. We need walls.
It's only been {day} days. Give it time.
We've been here {day} days now. It's home.
Some days it feels like a prison with no walls.
Quieter, since we lost one of our own.
Cold and quiet. We'll see who's still smiling come spring.
Not much to tell. I'm from {town}.
I'm just {name}. A pair of hands, that's all.
Not much to tell. I'm from {town}. I was a {background} before all this.

I was a soldier. I've seen things I don't talk about.
I fought for a lord who's dead now. Most of them are.
Farming folk, born and bred. Give me a field and I'll feed you.
I worked the forge. Hammer and anvil, all day long.

I kept company with rich folk. Let's leave it at that.
I dug graves. During the plague, I never stopped digging.
I travelled the roads, buying and selling. I've seen half the country.
I hunted. The woods were my home more than any house.
I worked underground. Strange to see so much sky now.
I built things. Houses, carts, whatever needed building.
I worked with my hands. Leather, mostly.
I kept a gaol. Funny how the keys don't matter once everyone's dead.
I'm young yet. Still figuring out who I am.
I've seen a lot of years. More than most out here.
And I'm not afraid of a scrap, if it comes to that.

I'm better at night. Mornings can go hang.

I don't need much. Never have.

In my own way.
I'm not much for prayer, if I'm honest.
